title: ipomoea tuberculata
intro: Ipomoea tuberculata, commonly known as the tropical morning glory, is a plant species belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea tuberculata are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits.
